# Test fixture manifest

Every file under `tests/fixtures/` must be listed here with its provenance. Fixtures are
**synthetic or pseudonymized**; no real handles, e-mails or raw records (WORK_ORDER §6). The
private-data scan fails on unlisted fixtures.

| File | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/generate.py` | Generator for the GH Archive fixtures below (M1-T3). Since M11 they serve the kept GH Archive connector's contract, privacy and rekey tests only (the velocity scan they were written for was removed, ADR-047.6). Deterministic; fake logins (`userNNNN`, `farmNNNN`, `helper-app[bot]`, `ci-bot`) and fake repos (`org-a/repo-1`, …). |
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/2026-09-20-0.json.gz` | Synthetic GH Archive hour (generated by `generate.py`): velocity burst on org-a/repo-1, bot star/fork. |
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/2026-09-20-1.json.gz` | Synthetic GH Archive hour: burst continues; lockstep farm burst on org-b/repo-2; malformed line. |
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/2026-09-20-2.json.gz` | Synthetic GH Archive hour: tail activity; background repo org-c/repo-3. |
| `tests/fixtures/hn/firebase_items.json` | Synthetic HN Firebase items (M1-T4, M1-T14, CB-02): fake ids 9000001–9000015, fake usernames `hnuserNNN`, fake repos `org-a/repo-1`, `org-b/repo-2`; includes a deleted and a dead comment. Hand-written; not real HN data. `tests/hn_fake.py` serves it and generates filler stories (`hnfillNNN`). |
| `tests/fixtures/hn/algolia_hits.json` | Synthetic HN Algolia search hits mirroring `firebase_items.json` (same fake ids and usernames). Hand-written; not real HN data. |
| `tests/fixtures/github/repos.json` | Synthetic GitHub repos (M1-T24; per-repo star history, events, GraphQL and search contract tests since M11): fake orgs `org-x`, `org-y`, fake ids 7000001–7000004, fake node ids, and the name of a synthetic star-history series per repo (generated by `tests/github_fake.py`). Hand-written; not real GitHub data. |
| `tests/fixtures/github/events_page.json` | Synthetic per-repo events page (M1-T24, CB-23): fake users `ghuserNNN`, a fake bot `helper-app[bot]`, Watch/Fork events plus Push/Issues/PullRequest events that must be dropped at parse; commit author `fake@example.org`. Hand-written; not real GitHub data. `tests/github_fake.py` serves it and generates more events (`ghuserNNN`). |
